text:
alex: quick eyes — PR #45123 is blocked by CI. mac-smoke failed in stage 2 on shard 7. 3 reruns, same failure. snapshot diff for UI asserts. buildkite job: bk/45123/987. Logs below. @devon @maria can you look? :eyes:

devon: looking now. can you paste the failing test name?

alex: failing test: TestSidebarRender::renders-collapsed-state
Snippet:
```
AssertionError: snapshot mismatch
- expected: <div class="sidebar collapsed">...
+ actual:   <div class="sidebar collapsed" style="transform: translateZ(0.5px)">...
```
Also couldn't repro locally on my linux devbox. only on mac runners.

maria: that's the flaky sidebar snapshot, we've seen intermittent DPI-related pixel noise on mac runners. usually a targeted rerun on the same shard fixes. did you try the retry button?

alex: clicked rerun 3x via UI, same result.

jordan: re: DPI noise, we bumped screenshot tolerance last week in infra. could still be a regression. @devon any snapshot threshold changes in this PR?

devon: i didn't touch any UI or snapshot config in this PR, it's just header/client changes. i'll spin a targeted rerun on a different mac agent: `bk buildkite retry --jobs 987 --agent=mac-5`

ci-bot: retriggered build bk/45123/988 on agent mac-5 — queued (requested by devon)

maria: if the rerun passes we can merge and add a short follow-up to bump tolerance if it keeps flaking. if it still fails, we should bisect across the last infra change.

alex: rerun just finished — bk/45123/988 — green! :tada:

jordan: nice. alex, can you update the PR with the rerun note and request a second approval? @sam can you take a quick look please?

sam: will glance in ~30m. if everything is green and nothing else changed i'll approve.

devon: i'll add a one-line CI note to the PR: "mac-smoke intermittently failing; green on targeted rerun; monitor next 24h"

alex: done. requested reviews from sam and maria. thanks all.

sam: approved. :+1:

maria: approved. :white_check_mark:

alex: merging now. will monitor post-merge telemetry for any regression. thanks everyone!
